```{r}
# AI-generated plot using the built-in mpg dataset
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Engine Size vs. Highway Fuel Efficiency",
    x = "Engine Displacement (L)",
    y = "Highway MPG",
  color = "Vehicle Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
